T: The frat's next door. So are the snacks.
D: A young couple with a baby go to war with the fraternity that moves in next door.
P: Serve the snacks when the frat throws its first party.
S: Sausage rolls with tomato sauce for the party. Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion, roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, slice and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Mac and Kelly at home with the baby
Cheese, crackers and grapes, a quiet night in for new parents. Arrange 150g brie, 150g cheddar, 200g crackers and a bunch of grapes on a board.
M: the backyard next to the frat
Grilled sausages and steaks with salad, a peace offering barbecue. Grill 8 sausages and 4 steaks.
W: Vanilla sheet cake with sprinkles. Bake a vanilla sheet cake from 300g self-raising flour, 250g sugar, 3 eggs, 200ml milk and 150g butter at 175C for 35 minutes.
K: Fruit punch with lemonade and orange slices. Mix 1L tropical juice with 1L lemonade and orange slices over ice.

s.how: Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion, roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, slice and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Mac and Kelly at home with the baby
s.how: Arrange 150g brie, 150g cheddar, 200g crackers and a bunch of grapes on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: the backyard next to the frat
m.how: Grill 8 sausages and 4 steaks. Serve with a bag of salad and bread rolls. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Bake a vanilla sheet cake from 300g self-raising flour, 250g sugar, 3 eggs, 200ml milk and 150g butter at 175C for 35 minutes. Ice and add sprinkles.

d.how: Mix 1L tropical juice with 1L lemonade and orange slices over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
